data: Mannheim - Neurosen zwischen Rhein und Neckar

Nach Feierabend treffen sich Mike (Torsten Eikmeier), Peter (Rainer Lott) und Enzo (Benedikt Crisand) regelmäßig, um in einer Blues-Band zu spielen. Jeden der Freunde treibt im Leben etwas anderes um: Mike und seine Frau versuchen seit einiger Zeit erfolglos, ein Kind zu bekommen, während Peter all sein Herzblut in die Musik steckt und auf eine große Karriere hofft. Nachwuchs-Schriftsteller Enzo hingegen wäre schon zufrieden, wenn wenigstens sein Privatleben reibungslos verliefe und sucht nach der wahren Liebe, an die er als hoffnungsloser Romantiker felsenfest glaubt. Als sie Aylin (Selale Gonca Cerit) begegnen, die an der Mannheimer Popakademie studiert und den Jungs einen Auftritt vor der Nase wegschnappt, sind sie zunächst sauer auf die quirlige und weltoffene Türkin, doch dann verfallen sie einer nach dem anderen ihren Reizen. (After work, Mike (Torsten Eikmeier), Peter (Rainer Lott), and Enzo (Benedikt Crisand) meet regularly to play in a blues band. Each of the friends has different concerns in life: Mike and his wife have been trying unsuccessfully to have a child for some time, while Peter puts his heart and soul into music and hopes for a great career. Aspiring writer Enzo, on the other hand, would be content if at least his private life ran smoothly and is looking for true love, in which he, as a hopeless romantic, firmly believes. When they meet Aylin (Selale Gonca Cerit), who studies at the Mannheim Pop Academy and snatches a gig right out from under the boys' noses, they are initially annoyed with the lively and cosmopolitan Turkish woman, but then one by one they fall under her charms.)

After work, Mike (Torsten Eikmeier), Peter (Rainer Lott), and Enzo (Benedikt Crisand) meet regularly to play in a blues band. Each of the friends has different concerns in life: Mike and his wife have been trying unsuccessfully to have a child for some time, while Peter puts his heart and soul into music and hopes for a great career. Aspiring writer Enzo, on the other hand, would be content if at least his private life ran smoothly and is looking for true love, in which he, as a hopeless romantic, firmly believes. When they meet Aylin (Selale Gonca Cerit), who studies at the Mannheim Pop Academy and snatches a gig right out from under the boys' noses, they are initially annoyed with the lively and cosmopolitan Turkish woman, but then one by one they fall under her charms.
